shadows.name: action
shadows.purpose: Primary actions and the empty-state glyph.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and checked-state feedback when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; background: #5b43d6; font: 700 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(91,67,214,.25); } .ds-primary:hover { background: #4931c4; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(91,67,214,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connection Input
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #cfd1db; border-radius: 9px; color: #171821; background: #fafafd; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5b43d6; outline: 3px solid rgba(91,67,214,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pin Toggle
components.css: .ds-pin { padding: 7px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; color: #4a33c4; background: #ebe8ff; font: 650 12px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-pin:hover { background: #ddd7ff; } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(91,67,214,.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Row
components.css: .ds-task { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px 1fr; gap: 11px; padding: 15px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e5ec; color: #171821; background: #f9f9fc; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-task:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-task i { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: #d28a26; } .ds-task strong, .ds-task small { display: block; } .ds-task small { margin-top: 6px; color: #686b78; }

narrative.overview: A narrow physical strip attached to the edge of a monitor: calm, dense, and immediately legible.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral canvas with one restrained violet accent.
Information-first rows instead of a card grid.
Compact controls that remain unmistakably interactive.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet marks selection, action, or live state; it is not background decoration.

dos: Do keep the in-progress list visible without navigation.
Do use native platform affordances for window behavior.
Do make connection and empty states actionable.
donts: Don't turn each task into a floating dashboard card.
Don't expose API credentials in renderer code or persisted plain text.
Don't add task-editing controls until read-only retrieval is proven.
